title: Ring Rumble
description: Pick one of eight original cartoon wrestlers and battle a friend on the same screen, or take on the CPU. Punches, grabs, slams, taunts and a huge finisher, all in a packed arena. Best in landscape.
notes: Calls element.requestFullscreen() from its fullscreen button; route it through the SDK. Two players share one keyboard or the on-screen touch pads. Loads Google Fonts (Bangers, Rubik). Cartoon slapstick only, no blood.
